description: Acterys Comments is a powerful Power BI commenting visual that revolutionizes data interaction by allowing users to add rich text commentary directly into Microsoft SQL Server tables. This Power BI custom visual supports extensive text formatting and integrates seamlessly with Power BI’s active filter context, enabling contextual commenting and enhanced storytelling. Whether you're explaining trends, adding annotations, or collaborating with your team, Acterys Comments turns dashboards into compelling narratives. It’s the ideal solution for teams looking to improve decision-making with collaborative Power BI visuals and seamless SQL write-back capabilities. Acterys delivers robust data management and analytics solutions, helping organizations turn complex data into accessible, actionable insights. Key Features: Rich Text Formatting: Use a comprehensive editor to format text with bold, italics, bullet points, and more. Effortless Text Integration: Add rich text and write comments in Power BI directly into Microsoft SQL Server database tables. Seamless SQL Integration: Store annotations securely in Microsoft SQL Server databases—on-premise or in the cloud. Collaborative Annotations: Enable team members to add insights that support storytelling and decision-making across dashboards.
